patch.after: List issues, filtered by status and/or assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues; use search_issues to find issues by text in title or body, and get_issue for one known ID. Returns at most limit issues (default 50). Comments are included by default, so set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

Search issues by case-insensitive text match on title or body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one known ID. No limit or status/assignee filters. Comments are included by default, so set include_comments to false for smaller responses.
Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Other values return an error. Omit for all statuses.
